notes: The run-cancelled marker rule (docs/plans/2026-11-23-1050-feat-run-cancelled-plan.md, R1 and R2).
A Run cell is marked when its trimmed text ends with (cancelled) or (canceled), in any case, with optional space before the parenthesis.
label is the text before the marker, trimmed. Footnote markers such as ** stay in label: the label parsers strip them in their next step.
A marked row is cancelled only when it has no attendance; a marked row with an x or a +1 is a normal run under its label.
Apps Script (SheetOps.js), the web (src/utils/runLabels.js) and Swift (RunLabel.swift) all read this file.
